# Bundled browser dependencies

- pdf-lib 1.17.1: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.min.js`; MIT license in `pdf-lib.LICENSE`.
- fflate 0.8.2: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/esm/browser.js`; MIT license in `fflate.LICENSE`.

These pinned files are served locally with the app. No CDN requests are made at runtime. Upgrades should replace the corresponding license and run the browser export tests.
